name: Lovey Dovey With You
source:
A girl who found this world boring, but somehow manage to get trapped in a cute otome game. The world is amusing unlike the reality, surrounding handsome boys. However...

[From [url=https://richalia.itch.io/lovey-dovey-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]

一個覺得現實世界無聊透頂的女孩，不知怎的竟被困在了一款可愛的乙女遊戲裡。不同於現實，這個世界充滿樂趣，身邊還圍著一群帥氣男生。然而……
